question: Who issues ₹10 notes in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reserve Bank of India:-**

 
 
• RBI is responsible for issuing all currency notes in India, including undefined10 notes.
 
• The RBI was established in 1935 and is India's central bank, responsible for regulating the country's monetary policy and managing its currency reserves. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **State Bank of India:-**

 
 
• It is a public sector bank that offers various financial services, including deposit accounts, loans, and credit cards. 
 
• It has a wide network of branches and ATMs across India and also operates in other countries.
 
 
 
• **Union Bank of India:-**
 
 
• It is another public sector bank that provides banking and financial services to its customers.
 
• It offers services such as savings accounts, loans, and credit cards and has a presence in various parts of India.
